description: Get a monitor's most recent completed check: status, whether it alerted, the extracted output (current and previous value), AI summary, and artifact URLs (screenshots, diff image, HTML snapshot). This answers questions like 'what is the price now?' or 'did anything change?'. pageAccess says what the browser reached; when reachedContent is false the check saw a challenge, login or error page, so report that, not a change in content. Its result is already shown to the user as that check's card (summary, screenshot and a Compare before and after button): do not also call get_check for the same check. When you link to a check, use its checkUrl (its comparison in monity.ai), never the raw screenshot, diff or HTML file URLs.
name: get_latest_result
title: Get latest result
